scripts.title: The Noon Panic
scripts.angle: A forgotten birthday becomes a last-minute cookie gift.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: It is already noon and I still have zero for her birthday.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Then skip the gift card and send something she can open.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: Like what that does not look last minute?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: David's has fresh-baked cookie gifts you can order online.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: Send me the link before I forget again.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: David's Cookies. Shop the cookie gifts.

scripts.title: The Party This Weekend
scripts.angle: No time to bake before a weekend party.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: The party is Saturday and I do not have time to bake.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Nobody said the cookies had to come from your oven.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: What would you send that still feels personal?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: David's sells fresh-baked cookie gifts for birthdays and everyday occasions.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: Okay, where do I order that?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: David's Cookies. Pick a gift online.

scripts.title: The Long-Distance Gift
scripts.angle: A remote family member wants the gift to feel close.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: I cannot be there, and another digital card feels cold.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Send something they can actually share at the table.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: What travels without feeling generic?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: David's online catalog is built around shippable cookie gifts.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: That is better. What is the site?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: David's Cookies. Shop the gift collection.

scripts.angle: A team celebration appears with no gift prepared.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: The team birthday just appeared on tomorrow's calendar.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: That calendar has excellent timing.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: What can I send that everyone will use?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: David's offers baked-goods gift assortments for occasions like that.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: Perfect. Send me the name.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: David's Cookies. Choose an assortment.

lines.speaker: Ava
lines.text: Dinner is tonight and I am not bringing another bottle.

lines.text: Good. Bring the thing people open before dessert.

selection.reason: The noon panic is instantly clear on mute, lands one supported proof point, and ends with the buyer asking for the link.
